prompt: Correct this BALANCED LEECH anatomy: the forward bead must be a counterweight on a short straight pin, with NO line-tie ring on the bead. Add the actual hook-eye as a small UPWARD eye immediately above the front of the fur body, BEHIND the bead. This is where indicator tippet attaches so it hangs level. Show a single jig hook curving upward behind the body, point forward. Keep marabou and white background.

Remove ALL the dangling swivels and clips below the tail. Connect the ONE rear stinger hook to the fly with a SHORT fine braided loop mostly concealed inside the rabbit tail, so only the hook bend emerges from fur. Keep dark cone and red eye, body, colors and style.

Make this a true marabou JIG: replace the downward-bending hook with ONE hook curving UP above the body, point forward toward weighted head. Put small line-tie eye UP on TOP of the round jig head at 90 degrees. Remove the forward-facing line-tie and decorative stick-on fish eye. Keep feather materials, colors, head and matte style.

Make this a true feather JIG: replace downward-bending hook with ONE hook curving UP above body, point forward toward weighted head. Put small line-tie eye UP on TOP of round jig head at 90 degrees. Remove forward-facing line-tie. Keep feathers, colors and matte style.

Correct this deer-hair SLIDER: Replace the long loose streamer fibers on the FRONT THIRD with a PACKED, closely clipped deer-hair bullet/wedge head, visibly trimmed hair tips, blunt tapered nose. Keep navy top, orange middle, white belly, pink throat on compact head. Keep loose grizzly hackle/bucktail at REAR ONLY, rubber legs, single hook and colors. This must read as a surface slider, not a baitfish streamer. White background.

Remove the three stiff antenna-like wires projecting UP from the frog's back. No wires or bristles on top. Keep the popper cup, eye, rubber legs, feathers and single hook unchanged. Plain white background.
